//: Copy to server/client/appsettings.Production.json. This is the Blazor WASM HOST (a static-file server that also exposes /Config). ApiUrl + IdentityUrl are served to the browser and MUST match the API's Identity URLs and the address you actually browse.
//SYNC: Mirrors the browser-facing keys of the engine's src/DevC.KPI.Startup/appsettings.json (source of truth). Only ApiUrl / IdentityUrl / AllowedHosts are functionally required here — the host's other sections (e.g. legacy Logging/IdentityServer) have framework defaults. No automatic sync: if the engine adds a browser-served setting, add it here by hand.
//urls: The /api base. The client appends 'api/...', so requests are /api/api/... — nginx routes /api to the API, which strips PathBase=/api. Both MUST match the API's Identity:IdentityBaseUrl and the host the user browses. On a real domain, set these to that host and restart.
//AllowedHosts: Host-header filter for the client host. Semicolon-separate multiple names; "*" allows any.
//Logging: OPTIONAL. Raise Default to "Debug" to troubleshoot the static host / Config endpoint.
